hints.title: Truck Capacity Bound
hints.text: With 3 trucks available for 2 initial logs, at most one log needs to be cut into two pieces.

hints.title: Oversized Log Identification
hints.text: Check if the maximum log length exceeds the truck limit k.

hints.title: Minimal Split Cost
hints.text: If x = max(n, m) > k, cutting a piece of size k leaves x - k, incurring cost k * (x - k).

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Overcomplicating cuts when only one log can exceed capacity.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify the truck capacity pigeonhole constraint.
